timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,340 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has weakened recently (returning to the 1340s after 3 trading days), making dollars more expensive for your conversion. More importantly, analyst commentary suggests the won could strengthen further to the 1200s range, meaning if you wait, you may need fewer won per dollar.

TIP: Consider dollar-cost averaging your monthly $2,000 purchases rather than converting in lump sums, to reduce the impact of unfavorable timing if the won does strengthen as analysts suggest.
